subject: general
question: There are 88 mobile phones, each of separate brands, arranged in a straight row at a mobile centre. The K brand mobile is 47th from the left side of the row and the M brand mobile is 34th from the right side of the row. How many mobile phones are between K and M brands?
solution:
**Given:**

There are 88 mobile phones, each of separate brands, arranged in a straight row at a mobile centre.

 \ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72ba5ab5a69340df1f4167292681e0891b673af0880a3cf28d06efeac6f22644.png] 

The K brand mobile is 47th from the left side of the row and the M brand mobile is 34th from the right side of the row. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb02132307c52e66d2536ef6b16b0d96f844d2c0854627211443f392a647b70d.png] 

→ 47th = 47 

→34th = 54 

Then, 54 -47 = 7 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83074c340cbb40fd041132e51cdc16e6d303ba217117f15aaf017a104701d4c6.png] ​

Mobile phones are between K and M brands are** '7'**.
